title: TimelinePatch
description: The structural evidence and transport of a change (R-1): a scoped batch of TimelinePatch operations, as the live-scene authoring code builds it (astrid/packs/rendering/editor/live-scenes/authoring.ts). DRAFT: op kinds are the three seen in that producer; scope is proposed from its capture object.

version.description: The timeline version the patch was built against (capturedTimelineVersion in the producer).

source.description: The extension id that authored the patch, e.g. haus.astrid.live-scenes.

scope.description: What the patch is allowed to touch: the project and timeline it was captured on. Proposed; the producer carries these in its capture object, not on the patch.

cutIds.description: Optional: the cut ids the patch may touch. Absent means the whole timeline.

operation.description: One TimelinePatchOperation. Families seen in the producer: track.add, clip.add, clip.update.
